data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's counterconditions leave a counterexample gap. The task domain can include deterministic, objective items that require expert inference not reducible to critical failure-mode checks; the checklist may yield 100% checklist compliance with zero errors on items it covers, while the panel still gets a critical branch wrong because the item required expert knowledge absent from the checklist. In such a single evaluation, there is no distinguishing evidence offered beyond the failure-mode framework, so genuine reliability gain cannot be separated from compliant box-checking that happens to be correct.
